titulo: Jobs and the workplace: Where and for whom I work

aula.objetivo: Say your job (without an article, with the feminine in -in), ask about other people's jobs, say where and for whom you work, and talk about your working hours.

sessao.titulo: Where and for whom I work

blocos.titulo: Where you work, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: ask «Wo arbeitest du?» or «Wo arbeiten Sie?». STEP 2: to give the PLACE, use «in» and the forms you know from lesson 9: der and das words take «im» (im Büro, im Krankenhaus, im Geschäft); die words take «in der» (in der Schule, in der Fabrik, in der Praxis). STEP 3: to say WHO you work FOR, or at which company, use «bei» — English uses "at" or "for": «Ich arbeite bei Siemens» (I work at / for Siemens), «bei der Post», «bei der Bank». STEP 4: hours: «Ich arbeite von acht bis siebzehn Uhr» (from eight to five). STEP 5: ask «Wie lange arbeitest du?» (how long per day) and «Wann arbeitest du?» (what time). STEP 6: two common situations: «Ich bin arbeitslos» (I'm unemployed) and «Ich habe frei / Urlaub» (I'm off / on vacation). At A2 you'll see why it's «im» and «in der»; for now, memorize the pairs.

tabela.resposta: Ich arbeite im Büro. / in der Schule. / in der Fabrik.
tabela.pt: At the office. / At school. / At the factory.

tabela.resposta: Ich arbeite bei Siemens. / bei der Post.
tabela.pt: At Siemens. / At the post office.

tabela.resposta: Ja, sehr gern. / Nein, nicht so gern.

blocos.enunciado: Say where and for whom 5 people work and what hours you work or study.
Write the feminine of 6 jobs and a sentence with each.
